title: Improve a Whole Sequence
description: The horizontal+vertical flow for raising a sequence's score. Start wide (score all), go deep (fix each), surface back (re-score). Prevents tunnel vision.

nodes.label: HORIZONTAL: Score all sequences
nodes.detail: Run the scoring one-liner across all registries. Sort by avg score. This takes 2 seconds and shapes the whole session.
nodes.code: python -c "import json, glob, os\n..." # see baseline scoring script

nodes.label: Which sequence to improve?
nodes.detail: Smallest artifact count × lowest score = quickest win. joints(11, 0.5) > arrays(4, 1.0) > biological_growth(3, 1.0). Don't start with wavefunctions(102) or randomness(114).

nodes.label: List all artifacts in sequence with per-field scores
nodes.detail: Show which fields are missing for each artifact. Group by registry file. Note which already have @identity in code.

nodes.label: VERTICAL: Read all GDScript files
nodes.detail: Use an Explore agent to read every .gd file for the sequence. Extract @identity, class_name, signals, joint types, key parameters. This is the deep dive.

nodes.label: Write Python script to batch-update registry
nodes.detail: One script that updates all artifacts in the sequence. Include description, qfep_connection, gamwell_reference, interactions, capacity, tags. Write to file, run, verify JSON valid.

nodes.label: Add @identity blocks to code files missing them
nodes.detail: Use Edit tool on each .gd file. Add 8-line identity block before extends line. Add class_name.

nodes.label: Batch capture AABB footprints
nodes.detail: Run capture_multi_angle for each artifact. Parse AABB output. Update registry footprint and size_group.
nodes.code:
for art in ART1 ART2 ART3; do
  godot --path . --xr-mode off --no-window --script res://commons/testing/capture_multi_angle.gd -- --mode=artifact --target=$art 2>&1 | grep AABB
done

nodes.label: Do artifacts need visual upgrades?
nodes.detail: Check screenshots. If gray boxes with no glow/trail/markers → yes, load artifact-visual-upgrade flow for each.

nodes.label: Visual upgrade batch (parallel agents)
nodes.detail: If artifacts share a base class, upgrade one by hand, then send 4-5 agents in parallel to do the rest. Each agent gets the pattern + the specific file.

nodes.label: HORIZONTAL: Re-score sequence
nodes.detail: Run the same scoring query. Compare before/after. Print the delta. This is the proof.

nodes.label: Avg >= 7.0?
nodes.detail: If yes → commit and move to next sequence. If no → identify remaining gaps and iterate.

nodes.label: Commit with delta in message
nodes.detail: feat: improve {sequence} artifacts — docs, code, screenshots\n\nSequence avg: {before} → {after}/8

summary: Score all → pick smallest×lowest → read all code → batch metadata → batch identity → capture footprints → visual if needed → re-score → commit.
